newsitem.title: USA: Brassie in talks with other parties.
newsitem.headline: Brassie in talks with other parties.

text.p: Brassie Golf Corp's president and chief executive officer, Bill Horne, said "we are in discussions with qualified parties with whom we expect to pursue business interests that should benefit Brassie."

"While no agreement is definitive as of late," said Horne, "we would be very disappointed if progress did not continue on course and an agreement not reached. As such, we continue to be enthusiastic about Brassie's future."
On April 4, the company announced a possible business relationship with the Tampa, Florida-based Divot Golf Corp.
